notes.title: Flesh Made Fear Demo – Now Haunting Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [h2][b]The time has come, sinners.[/b][/h2][p][b]Steam Next Fest[/b] has begun, and with it, [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] is clawing its way onto your screens with a challenging demo that takes you back to your childhood gaming era—playing horror games in the dark of your children's room. If you thought you were ready… think again.[/p][p]This retro-inspired PSX horror experience is here to test your nerves, your instincts—and maybe your soul. Get ready for gritty visuals, relentless tension, and a nightmare that doesn’t play fair.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]By the way ...  the fear becomes real this Halloween already![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="AxDBVgIlp44;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]💀 [b]What’s waiting for you in the demo?[/b][/h3][p]A slice of terror from the full game, with brutal encounters, grim environments, and no mercy. Whether you’re a seasoned survivor or fresh meat, we dare you to try.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The demo will kick your retro PSX butts—and you’ll thank it when it’s over.[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"][/img][/p][p]We're beyond thrilled to share this glimpse into the horror we’ve been crafting, and we’d love to hear your thoughts. If you enjoyed the demo (or barely made it through), leaving a short review would help us out tremendously.[/p][p]Thanks for playing—and good luck out there. You’ll need it.[/p][p][b]— Michael[/b][/p]

notes.title: 20.000 Wishlists! That’s enough to overrun a mid-sized village.
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you![/b] Flesh Made Fear has officially reached 20.000 wishlists, and I couldn’t be more grateful for your support.

Every wishlist helps bring this nightmare to life, and it means the world to know so many of you are ready to dive into the horrors that await.

I'll share more content soon - stay tuned, and thank you again for your support!

Cheers,
Michael

notes.title: Demo Update *Added D-Pad Functionality*
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/0c99eea3dcd1a21a573b3e2357695df364a07796.jpg[/img]

D-pad controls are now fully implemented for character movement in the demo.
Also, fixed a couple of typos on the game and also had Daniel Suraci re-record some of his voice lines. I have now updated his audio files with his new takes!

Thank you for the fantastic response and feedback to the demo so far! I look forward to sharing more with you all as development continues for the full release.

notes.title: Dare to play the demo? Go for it!
notes.notes:
Good day everyone,

The announcement of [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] was just a few days ago—and the feedback, support, and love for the game have been overwhelming(ly positive). I couldn't be more thankful; it has bolstered my confidence that I'm on the right track with this one.

It's been almost two years since the release of [i]Suffer The Night[/i] (my first big release). It's been a crazy ride so far, seeing ideas/stories I have in my head come to life through hard work and perseverance and having people play my games all across the world. It's been extremely rewarding and cathartic. 

With three projects under my belt now ([i]Suffer The Night, Terror At Oakheart, and Massacre at the Mirage[/i]), I finally feel I have the experience and technical skills to create something I've always wanted to make since I got into game design. 

With the focus on [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] now, I get to explore the realm that I grew up in: PlayStation One/Two-style survival horror. I've always had a massive passion for the genre, so I will endeavor to create an experience that captures that era's look and feel and hopefully gives a newer generation a look back.

Please join me on this journey and continue to support not just me but any indie developer who shows passion and hard work as they work to create fun and engaging games for people to play!

Speaking of which, there's also an opportunity available for you to support me even further, helping me make [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] even bigger and better—everything it can be!

I’ve just launched a Kickstarter—check it out! And with your help, I can:

[b][list]
[*] Add high-quality cutscenes and voice acting
[*] Expand the world with more levels, monsters, and weapons
[*] Polish the controls and camera systems for a better experience
[*] Create branching narratives for more replayability
[*] Bring the game to current-gen consoles!
[/list][/b]
Check out the Kickstarter now and help bring Flesh Made Fear to life! 🔪💀

👉 [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taintedpactgames/flesh-made-fear]Support on Kickstarter![/url]

And don't forget to play the very first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511700/Flesh_Made_Fear_Demo/]demo of [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] now on Steam[/url]!

[b]Thank you for all your support![/b]

Michael Cosio - Tainted Pact
